title: ALMA deep field in SSA22: Survey design and source catalog of a 20 arcmin<SUP>2</SUP> survey at 1.1 mm
question: Does the z=3.09 SSA22 proto-cluster show enhanced dust-obscured star formation, as seen in 1.1 mm source number counts over a 20 arcmin^2 ALMA map, relative to blank fields?

what.value: ADF22A source catalog and number counts
Blank-field counts used for double power-law fit

evidence.quote: we focus the counts from (cite: 2016ApJ...833...68A), (cite: 2016ApJ...822...36O), and (cite: 2016PASJ...68...36H)

what.value: SED template set for flux to LIR conversion

evidence.quote: using a template set of spectral energy distribution (SED) for ALMA-identified SMGs ((cite: 2017ApJ...840...78D))

recipe.method: ALMA pipeline calibration per tile; combine uv data; tclean with natural weighting, mosaic gridder, hogbom, uvtaper 0.5 arcsec
bane sensitivity map with 3 sigma clipping in 100x100 pixel boxes; aegean peaks above S/N=4; negative peaks used to set 5 sigma threshold
Inject mock Gaussian sources (FWHM 0.1-0.5", S/N 3-10), 1000 per S/N bin, re-extract with aegean
key_parameters: recovered if >4 sigma and within 1.0 arcsec

recipe.method: 2D Gaussian fits with imfit on primary-beam-corrected map; sizes from non-tapered map; bootstrap 95% CI for median
assumptions: IR luminosity from Danielson et al. SMG SED templates at z=3.09; Chabrier IMF; cosmology Om=0.3, OL=0.7, H0=70

recipe.goal: Cumulative number counts and blank-field comparison
recipe.method: Counts corrected for completeness and boosting, bootstrap errors, combined with ADF22A weighted by area; compared with double power-law fit to blank-field counts
assumptions: Fluxes scaled to 1.1 mm with modified blackbody, beta=1.5, T=35 K, z=2.5

recipe.goal: Compare to AzTEC and stack DRGs
recipe.method: Compare ALMA flux sums within AzTEC beam to deboosted AzTEC flux; stack 67 undetected DRGs at Ks positions on map smoothed to 1 arcsec, imfit for flux

evidence.quote: The typical 1$\sigma$ depth measured over a large central area of the map is 73 $\mu$Jy beam$^{-1}$.
Consequently 17 sources are found above S/N=5.
making a total of 35 ALMA sources in ADF22
At SNR=5, which is the detection threshold, the completeness is estimated to be $\sim$55%.
Sources with SNR$\sim$5 may suffer from $\approx$20% artificial increase of flux density
The median deconvolved major axis is $0.27_{-0.12}^{+0.05}$ arcsec
The median, $S^{\rm ALMA}/S^{\rm AzTEC} =0.70_{-0.10}^{+0.11}$, is well below unity.

not_stated_but_needed: CASA tclean parameters: image size, mosaic phase centre, niter, exact clean threshold and mask
Whether ADF22A and ADF22B were combined in uv or only catalog level
Aegean detection and fitting parameters beyond S/N=4 (seed/flood thresholds)
Flux bins and the exact bootstrap procedure for counts
Details of the AzTEC deboosting and source list
Archive-calibration scripts for ADF22A Cycle 2 data
Stacking aperture and positions (Ks catalog) and exact imfit settings
missing_for_reproduction: Counts flux bins and ADF22A-linked processing
score_reason: Main imaging and extraction recipe given, but several parameters and companion recipes missing; counts rely on literature.
rediscovery_reason: Data are archival ALMA projects and key results (source count, S/N, flux) are numeric, though some imaging parameters are missing.
